scope: Read-only existing reports, CPU checkpoint and stored source freezes; no extra probe/PPO/restart/budget action.

learning_admission.scope: Learning admission using actual task failure and MOD4 numerical/model/data integrity. Finite performance magnitudes and saturation usage are diagnostics. Hardware clipping remains enforced in the task. Not SCUT robot/physics equivalence or real-robot certification.

world_target.scope: Signed measured net along/cross progress over all actual full turns from first sample. Periodic lateral motion retained, not an instantaneous straight-line promise.
